value.rationale: The exact layer v2(n)=1 is mathematically natural from beta(2u)=beta(u), and odd successors with Omega<=3 are the first structural range where phi(m)/m can be below 1/2. The result removes all restrictions on the odd part u, proving a complete unbounded classification for the entire residue class, rather than making a routine finite increment from the prior prime-only case. It is a meaningful structural boundary for Toth’s stated consecutive-equality problem.
